_comment: Verified against real Game.log files (patches 3.21-4.10.2). Named groups are read by the parser. 'toggle' links a pattern to a Settings > Log Reader switch.

refinery_complete.regex: <SHUDEvent_OnNotification> Added notification "(?:A|(?<count>\d+)) Refinery Work Orders? ha(?:s|ve) been Completed at (?<station>.+?): " \[\d+\]

mission_ended.regex: <MissionEnded> Received MissionEnded push message for: mission_id (?<mission>[0-9a-fA-F-]+) - mission_state MISSION_STATE_(?<state>[A-Z]+)

gear_attached._comment: Loadout when the character loads in (begins with the Body_ItemPort line), then single items equipped later. Ids starting 2000000 belong to the front-end preview character.

gear_storage._comment: Station storage opened: its storage number and how many item stacks it holds. Item names are not logged.
gear_storage.regex: Freight Inventory Grid InventoryDataRequest Successful for Player\[[^\]]*\] Inventory\[\d+:Location:(?<num>\d+)\] Inventory Result Item Count:\[(?<count>\d+)\]

gear_move._comment: Every inventory request the player makes: Move (drag, with amount), Stack (dropped onto a stack of the same item; Target[] gives that stack), Store (put away; the item is in Item[]), Interaction (equip from a container). Inventories are <player>:Location:<n> for station storage, <id>:Container:0 for the backpack/armour, INVALID for hands/body. 4.10 tags it <Inventory Mgmt Request Queued>, older builds <InventoryManagementRequest>.
gear_move.regex: <(?:Inventory Mgmt Request Queued|InventoryManagementRequest)> Queued Request\[(?<req>\d+)\] Type\[(?<type>Move|Stack|Store|Interaction|Drop)\] for .*? Source Inventory\[(?<src>[^\]]+)\] Target Inventory\[(?<dst>[^\]]+)\]\. Source\[(?<code>[^\]]*)\] amount\[(?<amount>\d+)\](?: rank\[(?<srank>[^\]]*)\]\. Target\[(?<tcode>[^\]]*)\] amount\[(?<tamount>\d+)\] rank\[(?<trank>[^\]]*)\])?.*? Item\[(?<item>[^\]]*)\]

gear_move_result._comment: The outcome of a request above; anything but Succeed is undone
gear_move_result.regex: <Player Inventory Request Complete> Request\[(?<req>\d+)\] for .*? Type\[(?:Move|Stack|Store|Interaction|Drop)\] Result\[(?<result>[A-Za-z]+)\]

gear_placed._comment: An item put down in the world from the hands

gear_container_open._comment: A container being opened, by entity name and its inventory id: the player's own backpack/armour, a loot box, an NPC's armour, a crate
gear_container_open.regex: <Inventory Token Flow> Requesting access token for User\[[^\]]+\] on Inventory\[(?<code>[A-Za-z0-9_]+?)_\d+, (?<cid>\d+)\]

gear_died._comment: On death every item left on the body is listed, one line each; the first one marks the death

hangar_zone._comment: Something entering or leaving a hangar (tractor-beamed boxes, items carried in or out). Flaps at the boundary, so it is only judged once settled.

gear_storage_query._comment: Station storage listed in the inventory screen (also on load-in at that station); no count is logged

gear_elevator_up._comment: Freight elevator sent up from station storage: how many stacks and which storage, but never which items

gear_elevator_down._comment: Freight elevator going down into storage. Nothing about its load is logged; the next storage count shows how many stacks arrived.

play_time._comment: Time in the verse per session: from a verse loading screen closing (named for where you spawn: pu, Nyx, Pyro; Arena Commander maps are EA_…) until the main menu's loading screen (its load time taken off), the quit line, or the log's last line after a crash
play_time.menu_loaded: Loading screen for Frontend_Main : \S+ closed after (?<secs>[\d.]+) seconds
